Subject: Entitlement migration & guardrails: SSO/SCIM/IP cutover plan

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the kickoff today. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass cutover playbook for Cloudline's SSO + SCIM migration and the IP allowlist template. High-level ask: we want to do a staged cutover (canary users -> bulk sync) during the week of Nov 8 with a short preflight the week prior.

Questions I need from your side to finalize sequencing:
- Confirm the static egress IPs Cloudline will whitelist (or confirm we should use region level).
- Who is the service-account owner for your SCIM integration (name + email)?
- Do you have any custom attribute mapping for role/entitlement fields beyond standard groups?

Attached: redwood-sso-scim-playbook-v1.pdf, ip-allowlist-template.csv, cutover-checklist.xlsx (living doc).

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Cloudline to return IPs + SA owner by EOD Thu (Oct 21).
2) We run a preflight dry-run (no bulk sync) on Nov 1.
3) Canary sync for 50 users on Nov 8; monitor logs and rollback if mismatch > 2% entitlements.

If those dates work, I’ll lock in a 30-min preflight call for Nov 1 and a 60-min cutover window on Nov 8 with on-call Eng + CS in place.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Entitlement migration & guardrails: SSO/SCIM/IP cutover plan

Looping in an operational note — we should plan for two safety gates during the canary:
1) Attribute mapping verification (automated delta check that compares incoming SCIM attributes to expected schema; fail the job if `cloudline_role` missing for > 3% of accounts).
2) Entitlement reconciliation (post-sync sampling against their HR CSV for 100 users).

Rollback approach: if reconciliation mismatch > 2% then we immediately restore from last-good state (we keep KV cache snapshots and user diff logs for 48 hours). I’ve attached the cutover-checklist.xlsx with the verification steps and the monitoring playbook (see tab: Canary Validation).

I can own the rollback runbook and set up the alerting dashboards; Neha, can you take monitoring and post-cutover QA?

—Jordan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment referenced: cutover-checklist.xlsx

Thanks for the quick replies and details. Confirmed items from our side:

- We will request ephemeral SCIM credentials for Michael Cho; we recommend short TTL (12 hours) for the preflight, and a wheel-based ephemeral token process for the canary.
- For initial migration we recommend full-sync for the first run (ensures canonical state) and then delta syncs thereafter.

Preflight call: Nov 1, 10:00–10:30 PT (30 mins).
Cutover window (canary): Nov 8, 09:00–10:00 PT.

- Tessa: schedule preflight and cutover invites, publish final playbook (Tessa).
